description: This is a test helper source file for the 'teams' package in the Mattermost server, containing test setup functions, mock implementations, and utility methods for managing team-related test data.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: A helper struct for testing team-related functionalities, holding references to services, stores, context, and buffers.

classes.name: mockWebHub
classes.description: A mock implementation of a WebSocket hub with a Publish method.

classes.name: TeamService
classes.description: A service struct for managing team operations, referenced within TestHelper.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Mock method to simulate publishing a WebSocket event.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration using a provided function, if the config store is not read-only.

methods.name: CreateUser
methods.description: Creates and saves a new user, marking email as verified.

methods.name: DeleteUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes a user by ID.

methods.name: DeleteTeam
methods.description: Deletes a team and its associated channels and members.
